verses.text: Give ear to my words, O LORD, consider my meditation.

segments.text: Give ear to my words, O LORD, consider my meditation.

verses.text: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: for unto thee will I pray.

segments.text: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: for unto thee will I pray.

verses.text: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.

segments.text: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning will I direct
my prayer
unto thee, and will look up.

verses.text: For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with thee.

segments.text: For thou
art
not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with thee.

verses.text: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: thou hatest all workers of iniquity.

segments.text: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: thou hatest all workers of iniquity.

verses.text: Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: the LORD will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.

segments.text: Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: the LORD will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.

notes: 5.6 bloody…: Heb. man of bloods and deceit

verses.text: But as for me, I will come into thy house in the multitude of thy mercy: and in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.

segments.text: But as for me, I will come
into
thy house in the multitude of thy mercy:
and
in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.

notes: 5.7 thy holy…: Heb. the temple of thy holiness

verses.text: Lead me, O LORD, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face.

segments.text: Lead me, O LORD, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face.

notes: 5.8 mine…: Heb. those which observe me

verses.text: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part is very wickedness; their throat is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.

segments.text: For
there is
no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part
is
very wickedness; their throat
is
an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.

notes: 5.9 their mouth: Heb. his mouth, that is, the mouth of any of them

verses.text: Destroy thou them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against thee.

segments.text: Destroy thou them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against thee.

verses.text: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.

segments.text: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.

notes: 5.11 defendest…: Heb. coverest over, or, protectest them

verses.text: For thou, LORD, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield.

segments.text: For thou, LORD, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as
with
a shield.

headings.text: To the chief Musician upon Nehiloth, A Psalm of David.
